verdict.rationale: Claude Code has robust official MCP support: it can connect as an MCP client to hundreds of external tools/servers (stdio and HTTP transports, e.g. `claude mcp add`), and can itself run as an official MCP server via `claude mcp serve`, confirmed by both docs and a live CLI probe. (Note: the judge model and Claude Code share a vendor, Anthropic — this verdict rests on mechanically verified evidence: an explicit vendor-docs section titled "Use Claude Code as an MCP server" plus a live, keyless `claude mcp serve --help` probe, not favorable interpretation.)
